LanguageData.JJK_ExpeditionNoTile: No reachable expedition location was found near this colony. No contract was accepted.
LanguageData.JJK_ExpeditionConfirm: Accept a caravan expedition to a haunted settlement 2–8 tiles from this colony? You have 20 days to complete the objective and return to {2}. Clear the assigned spirits; rescue missions also require bringing the survivor home, and recovery missions require returning the specific sealed object. Rescued sorcerers join your colony. Reward: {1} × {0}, plus school reputation. Shares the school's active-contract limit and cooldown with local assignments.
LanguageData.JJK_ExpeditionAccepted: The school has marked a haunted settlement on the world map. Form a caravan and visit it. Complete the objective, then return to {0} and claim the reward in Jujutsu headquarters. The 20-day deadline includes the return trip. Bring food and medicine. Retreating does not reset enemies or loot.
LanguageData.JJK_ExpeditionUnvisited: Travel to the marked world site. The encounter has not been visited yet.
LanguageData.JJK_ExpeditionThreats: Assigned cursed spirits remaining: {0}. Downing alone does not count as exorcism.
LanguageData.JJK_ExpeditionCleared: The assigned spirits have been defeated. Secure any survivor or sealed object and bring the expedition home.
LanguageData.JJK_ExpeditionReturn: Return at least one expedition colonist alive to {0}, then claim the reward.
LanguageData.JJK_ExpeditionRescueReturn: Release the survivor after securing the site, then bring them and an expedition colonist alive to {0}. Use Reform caravan for the return trip.
LanguageData.JJK_ExpeditionArtifactReturn: Load the marked sealed cursed object into your caravan and return with an expedition colonist to {0}. The object is handed over when you claim the reward.
LanguageData.JJK_ExpeditionRecruitDesc: Once the assigned spirits are defeated, release the survivor. They join your colony and can travel in your caravan. Return them home alive to finish the assignment.
LanguageData.JJK_ExpeditionSecureFirst: Clear the assigned spirits and keep a colonist at the site first.
LanguageData.JJK_ExpeditionRescued: {0} joins the expedition. Bring them home alive.
